label: ext.blocktype ext.settings
createStatement: CREATE (b:ext.blocktype {id: $id, name: $name, properties: $properties, requiredProperties: $requiredProperties, semantics: $semantics, status: $status})

createParameters.name: ext.settings

properties.settings: the settings object: shell or extension settings as ordinary graph content

createParameters.semantics: Shell and extension settings as a versioned Block — only ephemeral cache lives outside the graph. Attaches to its extension's manifest by partOf like every other member and never materializes to the working tree; settings are runtime state read and written through CCGW. BO_0099_006
